_note: THE MINING FAMILY, 2: BLAST THE SEAM. Plan: home-office office/projects/delves/mining-family.md.
EVE's moon extraction in miniature: break it open, then collect. A use with an explosion and vanish (52a's own
fields) on a rock face, then a pickup of the core where it stood.
STAND-INS: the explosion (a blast, not 52a's incendiary; it must resolve or the lint refuses it) and both models.

FIXED 2026-11-10 (OT-36): the blast is fragGrenadeExplosion (his pod pick, Starfield.esm E574F); the core lands on REMarkerMediumLocRef (median 24 m from the face, gen_delve spread), so the words say the blast threw it clear.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Private Contract. Blast open the rock face at the <Place> on <Planet> and recover the ore core. Payment on contract completion."

message.title: Ore Core
message.text: Blown clear across the site, still warm. A fist-sized lump, heavier than rock should be, with a seam of metal through it.

beats.journal: I blew open a rock face at the <Place> and brought out the ore core behind it.
say: That's the one. If there's more of that in there, it was worth the charge.

broadcast: The good ore's behind the face, not on it. Set the charge, stand well back, and bring me whatever's shiny once the dust settles.
